1: #!/usr/bin/env bash
2: # Detached, idempotent launcher for #6369 Class-B residual EN re-enrich.
3: # Mirrors launch_enrich.sh under MemoryHigh=1.5G MemoryMax=2.0G.
4: #
5: # Runs entirely against the atlas-runner *work-dir* — it never mutates the
6: # VPS repo checkout at $REPO. This matters because the checkout there is
7: # routinely stale/dirty (large data/ dirs deliberately deleted for disk
8: # headroom); this launcher only ever reads from it (sources.db, kaikki
9: # lookup, the live hydrated manifest) and writes into $ATLAS_RE_ENRICH_WORK_DIR.
10: #
11: # Prerequisites (in the work-dir, deployed by
12: # launch_reenrich_class_b_remote.sh from the Mac side):
13: #   - class-b-no-en.json   residual slug allowlist (#6369 class_b_detail dump)
14: #   - reenrich_thin_manifest_entries.py   driver copy with --slugs-file
15: #     support, IF the in-repo checkout at $REPO is still stale (no
16: #     --slugs-file flag). The in-repo driver is preferred once it catches up.
17: #   - scripts/lexicon/... and its supporting imports, synced from the Mac
18: #     worktree so the driver never imports stale enrichment code from $REPO.
19: #
20: # Does NOT finalize, publish, or pin-flip. This mutates a *work-dir copy* of
21: # the manifest only. The Mac-side wrapper refreshes that copy from its live
22: # catalog before each normal launch; this script retains a live-checkout
23: # snapshot fallback only for direct VPS invocation. It never mutates
24: # $REPO/site/src/data/lexicon-manifest.json. Pulling the result back for the
25: # PR / publish gate is
26: # launch_reenrich_class_b_remote.sh's job, run from the Mac-side worktree.
27: #
28: # Usage (on the VPS):
29: #   scripts/lexicon/runner/launch_reenrich_class_b.sh
30: #   scripts/lexicon/runner/launch_reenrich_class_b.sh --limit 5   # smoke
31: #
32: # Env overrides:
33: #   ATLAS_RUN_ROOT, ATLAS_REPO, ATLAS_RE_ENRICH_WORK_DIR,
34: #   ATLAS_RE_ENRICH_CODE_ROOT, ATLAS_RE_ENRICH_RUNNER_PYTHON,
35: #   ATLAS_RE_ENRICH_UNIT, ATLAS_RE_ENRICH_DRIVER, ATLAS_RE_ENRICH_SLUGS_FILE,
36: #   ATLAS_SOURCES_DB, ATLAS_KAIKKI_JSON, ATLAS_LIVE_MANIFEST
37: set -euo pipefail
38: 
39: RUN_ROOT="${ATLAS_RUN_ROOT:-/home/ops/atlas-runner}"
40: REPO="${ATLAS_REPO:-$RUN_ROOT/repo}"
41: WORK_DIR="${ATLAS_RE_ENRICH_WORK_DIR:-$RUN_ROOT/run-class-b-reenrich}"
42: CODE_ROOT="${ATLAS_RE_ENRICH_CODE_ROOT:-$WORK_DIR}"
43: UNIT="${ATLAS_RE_ENRICH_UNIT:-atlas-class-b-reenrich.service}"
44: LOG="$WORK_DIR/reenrich.log"
45: PID_FILE="$WORK_DIR/reenrich-driver.pid"
46: WRAPPER_PID_FILE="$WORK_DIR/reenrich-systemd-run.pid"
47: SUMMARY_FILE="$WORK_DIR/reenrich-summary.json"
48: 
49: SLUGS_FILE="${ATLAS_RE_ENRICH_SLUGS_FILE:-$WORK_DIR/class-b-no-en.json}"
50: SOURCES_DB="${ATLAS_SOURCES_DB:-$REPO/data/sources.db}"
51: KAIKKI_JSON="${ATLAS_KAIKKI_JSON:-$REPO/data/lexicon/kaikki_uk_lookup.json}"
52: LIVE_MANIFEST="${ATLAS_LIVE_MANIFEST:-$REPO/site/src/data/lexicon-manifest.json}"
53: WORK_MANIFEST="$WORK_DIR/manifest.json"
54: 
55: IN_REPO_DRIVER="$REPO/scripts/lexicon/reenrich_thin_manifest_entries.py"
56: WORKDIR_DRIVER="$WORK_DIR/reenrich_thin_manifest_entries.py"
57: 
58: EXTRA_ARGS=("$@")
59: 
60: # Effective target: default missing-translation (this launcher's original,
61: # residual-slug-scoped behavior), but a caller-supplied --target in
62: # EXTRA_ARGS (e.g. #6466 full-catalog campaigns) overrides it. Mirrors
63: # argparse's own last-value-wins semantics for a repeated flag.
64: TARGET="missing-translation"
65: for ((_i = 0; _i < ${#EXTRA_ARGS[@]}; _i++)); do
66:   if [[ "${EXTRA_ARGS[_i]}" == "--target" && $((_i + 1)) -lt ${#EXTRA_ARGS[@]} ]]; then
67:     TARGET="${EXTRA_ARGS[_i + 1]}"
68:   elif [[ "${EXTRA_ARGS[_i]}" == --target=* ]]; then
69:     TARGET="${EXTRA_ARGS[_i]#--target=}"
70:   fi
71: done
72: 
73: # Test/debug hook: print the resolved target and exit before any
74: # filesystem/systemd side effect (tests/test_launch_reenrich_target_detection.py).
75: for arg in "${EXTRA_ARGS[@]-}"; do
76:   if [[ "$arg" == "--print-target" ]]; then
77:     printf '%s\n' "$TARGET"
78:     exit 0
79:   fi
80: done
81: 
82: mkdir -p "$WORK_DIR"
83: cd "$REPO"
84: 
85: if [[ -f "$PID_FILE" ]] && kill -0 "$(cat "$PID_FILE")" 2>/dev/null; then
86:   printf 'pid=%s log=%s\n' "$(cat "$PID_FILE")" "$LOG"
87:   exit 0
88: fi
89: 
90: # Prefer the in-repo driver once it has caught up (post-#6398 merge); fall
91: # back to the work-dir copy scp'd over by the Mac-side orchestrator.
92: DRIVER="${ATLAS_RE_ENRICH_DRIVER:-}"
93: if [[ -z "$DRIVER" ]]; then
94:   if [[ -f "$IN_REPO_DRIVER" ]] && grep -q -- '--slugs-file' "$IN_REPO_DRIVER" 2>/dev/null; then
95:     DRIVER="$IN_REPO_DRIVER"
96:   elif [[ -f "$WORKDIR_DRIVER" ]]; then
97:     DRIVER="$WORKDIR_DRIVER"
98:   else
99:     DRIVER="$IN_REPO_DRIVER"
100:   fi
101: fi
102: 
103: if [[ ! -f "$DRIVER" ]]; then
104:   echo "reenrich driver not found: $DRIVER" >&2
105:   exit 1
106: fi
107: if [[ ! -f "$CODE_ROOT/scripts/lexicon/enrich_manifest.py" ]]; then
108:   echo "synced enrichment package not found: $CODE_ROOT/scripts/lexicon/enrich_manifest.py" >&2
109:   exit 1
110: fi
111: if ! grep -q -- '--slugs-file' "$DRIVER" 2>/dev/null; then
112:   echo "reenrich driver at $DRIVER lacks --slugs-file support; scp the #6398 driver into $WORKDIR_DRIVER or update the checkout" >&2
113:   exit 1
114: fi
115: # --slugs-file (and its residual-dump prerequisite) only applies to the
116: # missing-translation target — see the guarded COMMON_ARGS block below for
117: # why stacking it onto full-catalog would be wrong, not just redundant.
118: if [[ "$TARGET" == "missing-translation" && ! -f "$SLUGS_FILE" ]]; then
119:   echo "residual slugs file not found: $SLUGS_FILE (sync it from the Mac worktree first)" >&2
120:   exit 1
121: fi
122: if [[ ! -f "$SOURCES_DB" ]]; then
123:   echo "sources.db not found: $SOURCES_DB" >&2
124:   exit 1
125: fi
126: # Fail closed (#6876): the driver imports yaml + jsonschema. A runner venv
127: # missing them dies mid-run with ModuleNotFoundError *after* systemd-run has
128: # already reported success, so verify the imports up front, before any
129: # filesystem/systemd side effect. Prefer the project .venv on the runner:
130: # $REPO first (its hydrated data sits next to it), then the work-dir overlay.
131: RUNNER_PYTHON="${ATLAS_RE_ENRICH_RUNNER_PYTHON:-}"
132: if [[ -z "$RUNNER_PYTHON" ]]; then
133:   if [[ -x "$REPO/.venv/bin/python" ]]; then
134:     RUNNER_PYTHON="$REPO/.venv/bin/python"
135:   elif [[ -x "$CODE_ROOT/.venv/bin/python" ]]; then
136:     RUNNER_PYTHON="$CODE_ROOT/.venv/bin/python"
137:   fi
138: fi
139: if [[ -z "$RUNNER_PYTHON" || ! -x "$RUNNER_PYTHON" ]]; then
140:   echo "runner venv python not found (tried $REPO/.venv/bin/python and $CODE_ROOT/.venv/bin/python)" >&2

142: fi
143: if ! "$RUNNER_PYTHON" -c 'import yaml, jsonschema' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
144:   echo "runner venv $RUNNER_PYTHON cannot import yaml/jsonschema; install with: $RUNNER_PYTHON -m pip install pyyaml jsonschema" >&2

146: fi
147: 
148: # Direct VPS invocation snapshots the live hydrated manifest into the work-dir
149: # only when the Mac-side wrapper did not already sync one. Normal remote runs
150: # receive a fresh Mac live-manifest sync before this launcher starts.
151: if [[ ! -f "$WORK_MANIFEST" ]]; then

155:   fi

157: fi

159: COMMON_ARGS=(
160:   --manifest "$WORK_MANIFEST"
161:   --local
162:   --target "$TARGET"
163:   --sources-db "$SOURCES_DB"
164:   --write
165: )
166: # --slugs-file restricts re-enrichment to a residual slug allowlist (see

168: # for missing-translation (this launcher's original purpose) but WRONG for
169: # full-catalog: full-catalog already selects every manifest entry, and
170: # stacking a stale --slugs-file on top would silently narrow it back down to
171: # whatever residual set happened to be synced to $SLUGS_FILE, defeating the
172: # whole point of a full-catalog run while still exiting 0 and looking done.
173: # (Existence of $SLUGS_FILE for this target was already validated above.)
174: if [[ "$TARGET" == "missing-translation" ]]; then
175:   COMMON_ARGS+=(--slugs-file "$SLUGS_FILE")
176: fi
177: if [[ -f "$KAIKKI_JSON" ]]; then
178:   COMMON_ARGS+=(--kaikki-lookup "$KAIKKI_JSON")
179: fi

181: # Wrap in bash -c so we can tee stdout (the driver's one JSON summary print)
182: # into its own artifact without fighting systemd-run's StandardOutput
183: # property. stderr still folds into the shared log.
184: #
185: # PYTHONPATH puts the synced work-dir package before the stale VPS checkout.
186: # The driver then imports the exact enrichment code deployed by the Mac-side
187: # wrapper, while $REPO remains available for its hydrated data files and venv.
188: # systemd-run --user starts units with a fresh environment (it does not
189: # inherit the launching shell's exports), so this must be set inside the
190: # wrapped command, not via `export` before systemd-run.
191: run_cmd() {
192:   printf '%q ' "$RUNNER_PYTHON" "$DRIVER" "${COMMON_ARGS[@]}"
193:   # Bash <4.4 (e.g. macOS's stock /bin/bash 3.2) throws "unbound variable"

196:   if [[ ${#EXTRA_ARGS[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then

198:   fi

200: WRAPPED="cd $(printf '%q' "$REPO") && PYTHONPATH=$(printf '%q' "$CODE_ROOT"):\$PYTHONPATH:$(printf '%q' "$REPO") exec /usr/bin/nice -n 10 /usr/bin/ionice -c3 $(run_cmd) 2>>$(printf '%q' "$LOG") | tee -a $(printf '%q' "$LOG") > $(printf '%q' "$SUMMARY_FILE")"
201: 
202: if systemctl --user is-system-running >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v systemd-run >/dev/null 2>&1; then
203:   rm -f "$PID_FILE" "$WRAPPER_PID_FILE"
204:   # Protocol path (atlas_job): Restart=no, optional RuntimeMaxSec, ExecStopPost
205:   # writes exit-status.json next to the per-job workdir. Default class-b runs
206:   # keep prior memory caps and also default Restart=no (no double-processing).
207:   EXIT_STATUS_FILE="${ATLAS_JOB_EXIT_STATUS_FILE:-$WORK_DIR/exit-status.json}"

216:   "${SERVICE_RESULT:-}" "${EXIT_CODE:-}" "${EXIT_STATUS:-}" > "$out"

1: """Target-detection regression test for the #6466 campaign launcher scripts.
2: 
3: Root cause covered: both launcher scripts used to hardcode
4: ``--target missing-translation`` + ``--slugs-file <residual dump>``
5: unconditionally. A caller passing ``--target full-catalog`` (the #6466
6: runbook's own documented invocation) would still get the stale residual
7: slugs-file filter applied on top, silently narrowing a "full catalog" run
8: down to whatever small residual set happened to be on disk -- exit 0, looks
9: done, campaign result is wrong. These scripts have no existing pytest
10: coverage (they are VPS-side bash, not imported Python), so this drives them
11: via subprocess with a ``--print-target`` debug hook that exits before any
12: filesystem/systemd side effect.
13: """
14: from __future__ import annotations
15: 
16: import subprocess
17: from pathlib import Path
18: 
19: import pytest
20: 
21: ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
22: LOCAL_LAUNCHER = ROOT / "scripts" / "lexicon" / "runner" / "launch_reenrich_class_b.sh"
23: REMOTE_LAUNCHER = ROOT / "scripts" / "lexicon" / "runner" / "launch_reenrich_class_b_remote.sh"
24: 
25: 
26: def _run_local_launcher(tmp_path: Path, *args: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
27:     env = {
28:         "PATH": "/usr/bin:/bin",
29:         "ATLAS_REPO": str(tmp_path),
30:         "ATLAS_RUN_ROOT": str(tmp_path),
31:     }
32:     return subprocess.run(
33:         ["bash", str(LOCAL_LAUNCHER), *args],
34:         capture_output=True,
35:         text=True,
36:         check=False,
37:         timeout=10,
38:         env=env,
39:     )
40: 
41: 
42: @pytest.mark.parametrize(
43:     "args,expected_target",
44:     [
45:         ((), "missing-translation"),
46:         (("--limit", "5"), "missing-translation"),
47:         (("--target", "full-catalog"), "full-catalog"),
48:         (("--target=full-catalog",), "full-catalog"),
49:         (("--target", "full-catalog", "--limit", "10"), "full-catalog"),
50:         (
51:             ("--target=missing-anchor", "--target", "full-catalog"),
52:             "full-catalog",
53:         ),
54:         (("--target", "missing-anchor"), "missing-anchor"),
55:     ],
56: )
57: def test_local_launcher_resolves_target(tmp_path: Path, args: tuple[str, ...], expected_target: str) -> None:
58:     proc = _run_local_launcher(tmp_path, *args, "--print-target")
59:     assert proc.returncode == 0, proc.stderr
60:     assert proc.stdout.strip() == expected_target
61: 
62: 
63: def test_full_catalog_does_not_carry_slugs_file(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
64:     """The bug this test guards: --target full-catalog must never also
65:     inject --slugs-file into the driver invocation (see reenrich_thin_entries
66:     -- a slug_filter silently narrows an already-selected target list)."""
67:     proc = _run_local_launcher(tmp_path, "--target=full-catalog", "--print-target")
68:     assert proc.returncode == 0, proc.stderr
69:     # The print-target hook exits before COMMON_ARGS is built, so this test
70:     # also asserts the source directly reflects the guard, since the
71:     # constructed argv itself is not observable via --print-target alone.
72:     source = LOCAL_LAUNCHER.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
73:     guard = 'if [[ "$TARGET" == "missing-translation" ]]; then'
74:     slugs_line = 'COMMON_ARGS+=(--slugs-file "$SLUGS_FILE")'
75:     assert guard in source
76:     assert slugs_line in source
77:     # The slugs-file append must be textually inside the missing-translation
78:     # guard block, not unconditional at COMMON_ARGS construction time.
79:     guard_idx = source.index(guard)
80:     unconditional_common_args = 'COMMON_ARGS=(\n  --manifest "$WORK_MANIFEST"\n  --local\n  --target "$TARGET"\n  --sources-db "$SOURCES_DB"\n  --write\n)'
81:     assert unconditional_common_args in source
82:     assert source.index(slugs_line) > guard_idx
83: 
84: 
85: @pytest.mark.parametrize(
86:     "args,expected_target",
87:     [
88:         ([], "missing-translation"),
89:         (["--limit", "10"], "missing-translation"),
90:         (["--target", "full-catalog"], "full-catalog"),
91:         (["--target=full-catalog"], "full-catalog"),
92:         (["--target", "full-catalog", "--limit", "10"], "full-catalog"),
93:         (["--target=missing-anchor", "--target", "full-catalog"], "full-catalog"),
